overview: The navigational heart of the Hapes Consortium's ninety-three-world isolationist realm.
history:
Hapes Cluster appears in records spanning the Old Republic, Clone Wars, Imperial era, Galactic Civil War, and Legacy periods. Archaeological surveys, holocrons, and veteran testimony preserve its place in galactic history.

Strategic value, cultural identity, and Force-sensitive traditions on Hapes Cluster shifted with each regime—from Sith occupation to Republic restoration and beyond.
significance: Hapes Cluster remains a reference point in Hapes Consortium surveys, trade lane charts, and military campaign planning across the nine saga films, series, KOTOR, and the Old Sith Empire.
notableEvents: Surveyed during the Old Republic expansion into Hapes Consortium
